batches.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Transparent game sprite sheet of The Last Unicorn, using the supplied image as the exact character reference. Preserve her elegant white unicorn identity: pale lavender-white coat, long flowing pale-lilac mane and tail, slender neck and horse muzzle, one long pale spiral horn, one peaceful closed eyelash eye, small serene smile, delicate gray-lavender hooves. Exactly four horse legs and four hooves; no wings, no clothes, no human arms/hands/fingers, no extra limbs. For two-hoof gripping actions, she may rear on her hind legs and bring both front legs together naturally like a horse, retaining hoof shapes and equine joints. Exactly EIGHT full-body poses in four columns and two rows, read left to right then next row. Consistent head and horn size, bold clean navy outline, soft pastel cel shading matching reference, three-quarter view facing RIGHT, generous transparent gutters; horn, mane, tail and all hooves fully inside every cell. ROW 1: 1 tug-of-war ready: hind hooves planted, body leaning BACK left, both front legs together extending forward-right at chest height to grip an invisible rope with hooves, determined happy expression; 2 tug heave: lean farther back, hind legs braced, same two front-hoof grip, cheerful exertion; 3 fishing reel ready: reared on hind legs, leaning back slightly, near foreleg reaching forward-right at chest height as if gripping an invisible rod, other forehoof beside it ready to crank, serene focused gaze right; 4 fishing reel crank: same rear stance and forward rod grip, other forehoof moved inward/down to crank invisible reel, bright smile. ROW 2: 5 overhead swing windup: reared with hind legs braced, both front legs together raised above right shoulder, empty hoof grip, gleeful serene face; 6 swing followthrough: both front legs moved forward-right and upward above the face, finishing a gentle overhead strike, happy smile; 7 putting ready: side-on facing right, standing with all four hooves planted and forelegs softly bent, both front hooves together low and forward-right around knee height holding an invisible putter, looking down-right; 8 putting followthrough: same stance, forehooves swung slightly forward-right after a gentle putt, looking up-right hopefully. Do not draw rope, rod, fishing line, bat, putter, ball, scenery, ground, shadows, text, labels, motion effects. True transparent background.
